title: Chapter 164
text:
After pondering for a while, Han Xiao made a decision.

"I want the PE-0 nano-synthetic fiber."

"You really know your stuff. I thought a warrior like you, who often goes on the battlefield, would choose the bulletproof membrane." Lei Zhen Yu was slightly surprised. "Pardon me for asking, but what do you want the fiber for?"

"To build something. I need enough PE-0."

"Okay." Lei Zhen Yu nodded. He felt that the PE-0 nano-synthetic fiber had the highest potential value among the four machines. The new material could be used with more machines. He secretly praised Han Xiao for being a high-level mechanic. His eyes were sharp.

After confirming the exchange, Han Xiao returned to the workshop and began to build the new Ghost sniper rifle. With the blueprint as a reference, everything was going smoothly.

"This exchange is worth a lot!"

Exchanging an incomplete electromagnetic gun for a new nano-material filled an important part of his lightweight mech design. The PE-0 nano-synthetic fiber could be used as the tendons and bones of the lightweight mech! Compared to the basic K600 endoskeleton, the PE-0 had a huge improvement in all aspects. It was small in size, light in weight, and had a lot of extra strength. It was also the core material of an excellent lightweight mech.

Viper – Lightweight Mech!

Although the PE-0's introduction was simple, when used as an endoskeleton, it was as flexible as a muscle.

As for the other three machines, two were consumables, so he directly eliminated them. The bulletproof membrane was not bad, but he had the platinum alloy, so it was barely enough for the bulletproof function.

After building a new Ghost sniper rifle, Lei Zhen Yu also brought enough PE-0 nano-fibers and put them in a metal box.

The two exchanged items. Lei Zhen Yu held the Ghost sniper rifle lovingly. Although the direction of his research was more towards micro machines, electromagnetic weapons were the blueprint for the next generation of conventional weapons. He also wanted to research it.

Back then, Old Man Lu privately asked him to come to Black Pine to help Lu Cheng. Lei Zhen Yu owed him a favor and could only come to this settlement to help. He had been bored. Today, he met Han Xiao, who was at the same level as him, and exchanged interesting machines. Lei Zhen Yu was in a much better mood.

"I need one more thing, but I don't have the means to buy it. I hope you can help me buy a 'bonfire' mini reactor." Han Xiao put away the box and spoke again. The thing he wanted was also a module related to mecha.

Lei Zhen Yu was a Master Mechanic. He knew many people in the same field and had many connections. If Han Xiao wanted to create machines with knowledge other than [Advanced Materials Science], he could just buy them from Lei Zhen Yu.

"That thing is not easy to get. Even if my friend in Ordina only charges me the cost price, it would still cost two to three million, and it would take some time to make it."

"Money is not a problem."

Han Xiao chuckled confidently.

Lei Zhen Yu was a master in the mechanic world and knew many mechanics of the same level. He was very friendly to Han Xiao and promised to help him contact the seller of the Bonfire Mini Reaction Furnace. To him, it was just a matter of a few phone calls.

After exchanging numbers, Lei Zhen Yu took the new Ghost sniper rifle and left. Han Xiao continued to work in the workshop until midnight. He finally finished all the work, turned off the lights, and left. He followed the guards to his temporary residence.

In the dead of the night, there was no nightlife in Black Pine Settlement. Once night fell, the residents would go home to rest. In the dangerous wilderness, they needed to maintain their energy to deal with any accidents that might happen at any time. Entertainment was very extravagant. Surviving in the wilderness, wild beasts, diseases, hunger … all kinds of disasters made the wanderers develop the vigilance to prepare for a rainy day.

Some of the survivors of the war from the old era were forced to join the Six Nations to make a living. Some had always lived in the wilderness and could not forget the hatred of their country. No matter how hard life was, they would not compromise. Some people thought this was stupid, but some people thought it was a belief or even a belief. No matter which country they were from, loving their country was worthy of respect.

The more important reason was that many wanderers were used to living in the wilderness. Although their meals were not stable and they did not know when they would be full, there were no restrictions. Freedom was like the intoxicating fragrance of flowers. After tasting it, some people were not willing to give up their freedom even though they knew that joining the Six Nations would give them food and clothing.

In the peaceful era, many people were numb to life. But now, in order to survive, they were like their ancestors, eating raw meat and drinking blood. Every day was full and lively. Most wanderers were thin and sallow, but their physical fitness was much better than the city residents. They were strong and hardworking.

The wilderness was seen as a wasteland. Many abandoned cities and battlefields were occupied by plants and wild beasts. There was also the radiation zone caused by war. It was a forbidden land for life. The Six Nations did not have the intention to expand the wilderness at the moment. The cost was too high, and the value was not high. In the first few years after the war, the Six Nations focused on stabilizing the domestic environment and did not have the spare resources to expand their territory. So, all kinds of forces grew wild in the wasteland, forming the structure of wanderers, warlords, and large financial groups. Just like the wind that blew after everything was destroyed, the wasteland after the war once again lit up with a weak flame of order.

…

The next morning, Han Xiao brought Mad Blade, Angry Sword, and Pork Bun to him.

"I'm going to leave for a while. You guys stay in Black Pine. I'll contact you again."

Pork Bun did not respond to Angry Sword, but Mad Blade and Angry Sword were reluctant to leave. They had only hugged his thigh for a few days, and now they were going to be abandoned again.

"You guys can think of a way to deal with the plague in Black Pine." Han Xiao pointed at Mad Blade and said, "I'm very optimistic about the potential you've shown. Maybe you have the ability to use better weapons."

Han Xiao took out two new large-caliber pistols. The Kroger SPX model was suitable for a range of 80 meters. It was green quality and was twice as powerful as the pistols Han Xiao sold to other players. He handed them to Mad Blade and Angry Sword.

"These are for me?" Mad Blade asked in disbelief.

Han Xiao nodded with a smile.

Mad Blade was pleasantly surprised. He played with the two pistols in his hands. He did not expect to receive such benefits. Han Xiao actually gave him equipment. Pork Bun's mouth was wide open.

Was this also the benefit of the hidden quest? As long as you perform well, Black Phantom will give you benefits from time to time?

Han Xiao had specially made these two pistols so that Mad Blade and Angry Sword could do more missions. If a worker wanted to do a good job, he had to sharpen his tools first. Also, when he was giving out benefits, he could record Pork Bun beating Angry Sword. Once it was made into a video, more players would see this scene. They would know that the benefits here were good, and they would yearn for his' hidden quest 'even more.

All he had to give was handguns that could be easily made and a little bit of generosity. It was a win-win situation.

"I think you have a lot of potential in fighting. You should learn some close combat skills." Han Xiao said. Mad Blade was talented in fighting and was suitable for becoming a Mechanical Pugilist. He naturally hoped that Mad Blade could be as strong as he was in his previous life. A Mechanical Pugilist could also use Mad Blade's talent in the Pugilist class … probably.

Frenzied Sword nodded in agreement. What Han Xiao said was exactly what he was thinking.

After giving out all the orders, Han Xiao boarded the Dark Net helicopter and left Black Pine.

"Black Phantom has left," the assistant reported to Lu Cheng.

Lu Cheng nodded. He had a good impression of Han Xiao. He said, "Take good care of his two friends. Also, pay attention to the strange refugees in Green Valley Town. Find out where they came from."

…

He took the helicopter to Fabian's stronghold and switched to a transport plane to head to the next novice village in the Southern Continent. This time, he was chartering a long-term flight. He even had to cross the ocean to the novice villages in the Western and Northern Continents. Fabian's influence in the other two continents was not as big, so the price of chartering a flight was very expensive. Even if Antonio gave him a discount, the price would still make normal players stunned.

He still had plenty of money in his Dark Net account. He had all kinds of ways to make money, so he was not worried about running out of money.

On the plane, Han Xiao started to officially create his own mechanical suit. One of the benefits of creating a mechanical suit was that the various modules could be created separately, then finally tested and linked together. This way, risks could be avoided, and the success rate of self-creation would be much higher.

Although he did not have the blueprint, he had his own ideas. The various functions of the self-created mech could be imitated according to the other mechs in his memory. [Viper Light Mech] was a standard advanced rare equipment. If one wanted to obtain this blueprint through normal means, they would need to fuse four advanced knowledge combinations. The requirements were very strict. The prerequisite was to understand the blueprints of the various components, so players could only try their luck.
